'''Millie''' (Japanese: '''ミリ''' ''Millie'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG083|Unfair Weather Friends]]''.

Millie was a new employee at the [[Weather Institute]] near [[Fortree City]]. What [[Bart]] and the other scientists at the Institute didn't know was that the person they thought was Millie was actually [[Brodie]], an agent from [[Team Magma]] who was undercover to steal ancient {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} data.

After Brodie escaped with the data, the real Millie showed up at the Institute. At first, everybody was cautious and wondering why Brodie had returned. However, {{an|Brock}} was convinced that it was indeed the real Millie, as he had fallen in love with her, but not Brodie in disguise. Soon after, Bart quickly put Millie to work, having her type up all of the ancient Pokémon data from the Institute's hard copies into the computer system.

She was mentioned by [[Max]] in ''[[AG119|The Ribbon Cup Caper]]''.
